summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, announcing next steps regarding a Share Capital Amendment approved at its June 17, 2026 annual meeting. This amendment is part of a going-private transaction under SEC Rule 13e-3, as referenced in a Schedule 13E-3 filed April 4, 2026. The transaction includes suspending SEC reporting, deregistering under the Exchange Act, and continuing as a Canadian reporting issuer, aiming to reduce costs. The registrant (issuer) is taking itself private. Watch for TSX approval and completion of the SEC reporting suspension; the risk is regulatory or shareholder challenges to the going-private process.
